[[File:Names.png|thumb|right|250px|The top five baby names of 22 BBY]]
A name that was described as "'''(sharp keening at 85 cycles, followed by five atonal mandible clicks)'''" was highlighted to be the fifth most popular infant name in a list compiled sometime in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="BabyNames">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49||A Closer Look}}</ref> [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Dating">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49||A Closer Look}} mentions the list of infant names in an [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|news issue]] dated to 13:3:28, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], according to the reasoning presented [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> The name&mdash;along with the names [[Losibaru]], [[Janara (name)|Janara]], [[Barada (name)|Barada]], and [[Gaeriel]]&mdash;was listed in a recurring column called "A Closer Look," which was featured in the [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|forty-ninth]] installment of the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo District]] edition of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News's]] 531st volume.<ref name="BabyNames" />

==Behind the scenes==
"(Sharp keening at 85 cycles, followed by five atonal mandible clicks)" was listed in a<ref name="BabyNames" /> [[March 28]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN49 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6217551|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Dev Sibwarra|date=2002-03-28|time=4:24 PM}}</ref> sidebar of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] that showcased a selection of the most popular baby names. This feature appeared in the forty-ninth issue of this promotional [[in-universe]] tie-in, which was published shortly before the release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. Unlike the other listed baby names, this name was described as a sequence of sounds.<ref name="BabyNames" /> It was inserted into the list by [[Lucasfilm]] executive [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as a joke, who was glad to see that it received an entry on [[Wookieepedia]], the ''[[Star Wars]]'' wiki.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1432174871111475203|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=I think this was my joke. Glad to see it got a Wookieepedia article. :)}}</ref> The site's content was written by Hidalgo and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
